articles.title: Chiefs hit bye week aiming to sort out uneven play
articles.summary: The Chiefs are hoping to learn from their uneven first half as they head into a bye this week. "How can we deal with that adversity? You can only learn from so many losses. You've got to learn from it fast," Patrick Mahomes said.

articles.title: Henley plays on for Chargers after brother killed
articles.summary: Daiyan Henley played for the Chargers two days after his brother was shot and killed in Los Angeles. He had a sack, a pass deflection and seven tackles in the win over the Titans, later saying: "As traumatizing as all this is, I got a job to do."
